assessments.reasoning: Assignment calls the assignable relation. The comparison examines the required target property by name and its corresponding source type and separately rejects access/origin/versioned type mismatches where applicable. Class implementation declarations are not a prerequisite to the fixture's structurally compatible public property.

The official CLI accepted the class instance with a matching public field and an extra instance field. The incompatible type and unrelated private origins produced TS2322. The fresh object literal with an extra key produced TS2353.

limitations: The assessed implementation profile covers a public instance property. Private-member origin, excess property checks on fresh literals, and other assignment rules have separate conditions.
